messages:
sara_sales: Heads-up — NebulaHealth's vendor-risk team pushed a privacy/security pack request: DPA + SCCs + SIG/CAIQ answers. They want this back by Fri EOD. Anyone available to help with presales + security Qs? cc @alex_se @elena_privacy

alex_se: On it. Quick clarifying Q — Nebula asked if customer-managed KMS/HSM is required or acceptable. Their Q12 specifically wants KMS ownership options.

elena_privacy: We can provide a DPA + SCCs template. For DSARs/data deletion they want deletion within 30 days and audit logs removed. That's stricter than our default 90d logs. Do we know the deployment mode they're targeting?

mike_security: NebulaHealth is evaluating Dedicated/Private. If they go Private (VPC) we can offer customer-managed KMS which should satisfy the HSM/KMS requirement. For logs: we can implement a 30d retention for user content and a separate billing trace policy.

sara_sales: They flagged 'data residency' + 'deletion timeline' as immediate blockers for procurement. Can we commit to SIG CAIQ answers + a DPA redline by Thursday?

alex_se: I'll start the SIG CAIQ draft today. For the dataflow/retention Qs we should include a short snippet in the doc: 
```
# example retention override for NebulaHealth POC
retention.user_data_ttl_days = 30
retention.audit_logs_retention_days = 90  # hashed/billing traces only
```

elena_privacy: That approach works. Important: make explicit in the DPA that PHI/PII will be purged from logs within 30d; hashed billing traces may be retained up to 90d solely for billing and fraud detection unless customer requests earlier deletion. I'll draft the clause: "we retain billing-only hashed traces for up to 90 days unless otherwise requested in writing."

mike_security: We have a DSAR/Deletion runbook in Ops. Example script (pseudo):
```bash
# dsar_export.sh --exports user data and purges logs
./scripts/dsar_export.sh --user-id $USER_ID --export /tmp/$USER_ID.json --purge-logs --notify ops@redwood.com
```
I'll paste sanitized example into the SIG answers.

sara_sales: Also price implication question: Private deployment + customer KMS + 30d custom retention — will that change the quote? @julia_fp can you confirm delta?

julia_fp: Yes, Private + KMS + retention SLA is an infra/svc surcharge. I'll run numbers and post a conservative estimate by EOD tomorrow; initial estimate ~+15% to monthly committed.

alex_se: Uploading initial SIG CAIQ draft + DPA redlines to the internal folder now: https://redwood-internal/documents/nebul a-health/sig-ca iqa-dpa-draft (will fix link after upload) :eyes:

elena_privacy: One legal ask — need signoff on modified DPA 'right to deletion' timeline and subprocessors. @legal-bot please route to legal.

legal-bot: Legal assigned: @tanya_legal. Tanya will take this and aim to review by Thursday.

tanya_legal: I'll review the DPA redlines and the SCC Annex changes. Two immediate items: confirm current subprocessors list and ensure Annex 1 SCC references are updated for EU transfers. I'll coordinate with infra/ops.

sara_sales: Great — action items: Alex - SIG + DPA draft (Thu), Mike - DSAR runbook snippet (today), Julia - pricing delta (tomorrow EOD), Tanya - legal review (Thu). We'll present consolidated packet to NebulaHealth on Friday AM. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
